1981-5147-7173.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1981-5147-7173.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2645-2930-3430-5621.easyPrerequisites: Portent Tracker doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-2930-3430-5621.description:
Activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping Arid Archway
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Portent Tracker.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1339-2835-4247.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2835-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

720-1806-2034-2403.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
720-1806-2034-2403.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adidng {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Kinzu of the Bleak Coven and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Kinzu of the Bleak Coven trigger, causing you to pay 2 life and exile Eternal Scourge from your graveyard to create a token copy of it that is 1/1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eternal Scourge token dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

628-2018-6261.description:
Activate Bulwark Ox by sacrificing it.
When Bulwark Ox dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Bulwark Ox from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bulwark Ox ability
Activate Bulwark Ox by sacrificing it.
When Bulwark Ox dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Bulwark Ox from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Bulwark Ox ability
Repeat

3234-3293-5226-6495.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5226-6495.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5226-6495.notes:
You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4478-5982.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4478-5982.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Ancient Gold Dragon, triggering Breath of Fury and Ancient Gold Dragon.
Resolve the Ancient Gold Dragon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

129-1409-4068-6723.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
129-1409-4068-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

215-647-3443.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-647-3443.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-647-3443.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

3212-5256-5659-5929.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Kefnet.
When God-Eternal Kefnet dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Kefnet's power, which will cause you to mill God-Eternal Kefnet.
As God-Eternal Kefnet is a Lhurgoyf due to Leyline of Transformation, Disa's first ability triggers, returning God-Eternal Kefnet from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

997-1806-2060-5902-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

2906-6867-7042.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
2906-6867-7042.description:
Cast Appa, Steadfast Guardian by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa, Steadfast Guardian enters, it triggers, airbending Appa, Loyal Sky Bison
Cast Appa, Loyal Sky Bison from exile by paying {0}.
Appa, Steadfast Guardian triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Appa, Loyal Sky Bison enters, it triggers, airbending Appa, Steadfast Guardian
Cast Appa, Steadfast Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

5739-6899.easyPrerequisites: Caduceus and With Great Power... are attached to the same creature.
5739-6899.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 30 or higher.
5739-6899.description:
Whenever damage would be dealt to you, With Great Power... causes that damage to be redirected to the creature it is attached to.
Since Caduceus grants an ability to the creature preventing damage being dealt to it, no damage is dealt to you or to that creature.
5739-6899.notes: This effect will persist so long as you have 30 or more life.

4659-5220-5946.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken artifact creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
4659-5220-5946.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers excluding the creature mentioned above.
4659-5220-5946.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5686-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

104-4476-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-4476-5641.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

759-1247-3028-5963-6549.description:
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Grove of the Burnwillows to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Marvin using Grove of the Burnwillows' second ability by tapping it, adding {R} or {G} and causing each opponent to lose 1 life due to Tainted Remedy.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

1268-1283-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.
1268-1283-3918.notes: Once you have enough mana, you can use Chromatic Orrery's second ability instead.

631-997-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
631-997-6249--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Grim Haruspex trigger.
Resolve the Grim Haruspex trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

957-1018-2061.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Skullwinder.
When the Skullwinder token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second turn.

2292-3391-4871-6019.description:
Activate Korozda Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{B}{G} and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Korozda Guildmage ability, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Driver of the Dead

624-2777-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni, Undying Partisan by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
Resolve the Yahenni, Undying Partisan ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2517-4608.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five enchantments.
2517-4608.description:
Activate Parallax Wave by removing a fade counter from it, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
You may repeat step 1 as desired until Parallax Wave has exactly one fade counter on it.
Activate Parallax Wave by removing a fade counter from it, exiling itself.
When Parallax Wave leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield under their owner's control.
Resolve all Parallax Wave abilities from steps 1 and 2, exiling the chosen creatures.
Repeat as desired, or whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
You may use this method to blink creatures/enchantments you control if you resolve the Parallax Wave abilities before exiling Parallax Wave.

4050-4314-4516.notablePrerequisites: There have been a number of permanents sacrificed this turn equal to five plus The Balrog's commander tax.
4050-4314-4516.description:
Cast The Balrog from the command zone by paying {B}{R}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The Balrog, adding {B}.
Choose to return The Balrog to the command zone from your graveyard.
When The Balrog dies, it and Pawn of Ulamog trigger.
Resolve the Balrog trigger, destroying any artifact and/or creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1479-1671-2638.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1671-2638.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it, Tireless Tracker, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
